title: JANUS Engine — Howl's Moving Castle RUN-008 full measured energy balance preregistration
important_boundary: RUN-008 is now frozen before observing the missing JANUS hardware measurements. No final measured-net verdict will be generated until R0P1 P0-P7 data are ingested.

frozen_architecture.gill: 21.2109 m2 POMS sectorized annular cross-flow concept; actual achieved J_O2 must be measured
frozen_architecture.fuel_cell: PEMFC with explicit external H2 fuel; actual low-pO2 gross/net conversion measured on the article
frozen_architecture.axle_drive: coreless/slotless AFPM bidirectional starter-generator; micro-EPM receives zero benefit credit unless separately measured
frozen_architecture.energy_buffer: dual managed batteries A/B; authoritative stored-energy metric E_A + E_B
frozen_architecture.scale_management: low-hardness water + low-adhesion wall + Axle/wiper + crystal trap; all added DeltaP/torque included
frozen_architecture.purge: nominal 1800 s heartbeat; event energy, gas mass and pressure loss measured rather than assumed

predeclared_energy_equations.P_aux: sum of all simultaneously active metered auxiliary loads
predeclared_energy_equations.P_net_bus: P_PEMFC + P_verified_regen + P_battery_discharge - P_aux - P_battery_charge - P_export
predeclared_energy_equations.battery_neutral: E_A_end + E_B_end >= E_A_start + E_B_start with external charger disconnected over the declared stabilized window
predeclared_energy_equations.exportable_surplus: positive energy remaining after internal loads and restoration of both declared battery reserve targets

known_comparators_not_admitted_as_RUN008.old_RUN007_nominal_shadow_result: 0.130 mg/m2/s with 40% rating and old auxiliary envelope produced +8.33 Wh at 6 h; comparison only, not evidence

reason: The remaining information cannot be obtained honestly by additional simulation alone. Physical subsystem metering is the next evidence source.
anti_self_deception_rules: A POSITIVE BATTERY B DELTA DOES NOT COUNT IF BATTERY A LOST MORE ENERGY
NO REGEN CREDIT WITHOUT MEASURED EXTERNAL SHAFT/HYDRAULIC WORK OR ROTOR DECELERATION
FLOW RATE IS NOT PUMP POWER
RATED COMPONENT EFFICIENCY IS NOT MEASURED SYSTEM EFFICIENCY
UNKNOWN PARASITIC CANNOT BE SET TO ZERO
OXYGEN IS OXIDIZER; HYDROGEN IS EXPLICIT CHEMICAL FUEL
next_action: Acquire R0P1A-compliant P0-P7 dataset, then supersede this v0.1 preregistration with RUN-008 v1.0 containing measured integrals and uncertainty.
